explanation: A young shepherd who later becomes king of Israel and a central figure in 1 Samuel.
The first king of Israel, who hunts David because he is jealous of his success and fears that he will take the throne.
A wilderness region southeast of Hebron where David hides from Saul.
Commander and cousin of King Saul, who protects and supports him in the pursuit of David.
A wise counselor who first serves Saul and later David.
A rich man who refuses to help David and his men, leading to conflict.
Nabal's wise and beautiful wife who prevents a bloody conflict between David and Nabal by giving them food and drink.
The Almighty Creator who, according to Genesis, created the heavens, the earth, and all life.
